messages:
pat: starting late-window slim quant rollout now. target image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12. window 03:00-05:00 UTC. plan: stagger 5%->20%->60%->100%. i'll own first 40m.
nina: thanks. confirm we've built with vf_kernel patch? that was supposed to fix small mem churn.
sam: yes vf_kernel applied in build b12. i pushed image earlier. i'll issue pin before canary.
chris: rollback criteria: any OOM >1 in a region OR p99>250ms for >3min OR error rate >1.5%. unsettle if kv_miss_rate doubles.
sam: pin: `/deploy pin service=engine image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 ttl=8h reason="late-window slim quant"`
deploy-bot: Pin created id=pin_20240402_b12 target=engine image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 expires_in=8h pinned_by=sam
sre-ops: prewarmed us-east and eu-central. ap-southeast has lower capacity; adding +3 replicas to canary pool there. avoid swapping batch jobs 03:30-03:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary start rollout_id=roll_3472109999_c1 step=5% watch=6m auto-fallback=true
pat: canary 5% out, initial telemetry coming in. enabling tracing at 15% for 30m.
(6m)
pat: canary 5% looks fine. p95 +8%, errors flat. moving to 20%.
deploy-bot: progressed to 20% step_2 watch=6m
sre-ops: ap-southeast reported 2 OOMs across two pods at ~20% step; kube restarted them. no client errors yet, but node logs show `cuda_alloc_failure` in driver.
chris: that triggers our OOM rule. recommend immediate partial rollback for ap-southeast and pause global progression.
sam: agree. execute partial rollback ap-southeast to engine:previous.
deploy-bot: Partial rollback: region=ap-southeast from engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12 -> engine:previous. Rollout paused globally.
pat: rolling back ap-southeast done. holding at 20% for 15m to observe.
sre-ops: after restart we still see one worker with driver warning and slight memory leak signs. collecting `dmesg` and driver logs now.
(10m)
chris: request: extend pin TTL by +4h so we can cut a patched build and test without losing immediate rollback option.
sam: `/deploy pin extend id=pin_20240402_b12 add_ttl=4h reason="patch testing"`
deploy-bot: Pin extended: id=pin_20240402_b12 new_ttl=12h extended_by=sam
pat: ops: can we run a focused soak in eu-central with the quant weight reorder flags disabled? i want to see whether kernel path is the culprit.
sre-ops: starting soak in eu-central with env var `QUANT_REORDER=0` on a small slice (10 pods). will report in 12m.
(12m)
sre-ops: soak report: no OOMs, latency stable. suggests interaction between reorder and ap-southeast driver combo.
chris: good signal. decision: keep global rollout paused. we'll cut engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12a with reorder disabled and driver shim for ap-southeast. devs to build and smoke.
sam: building b12a now. ETA ~20m for image and staging smoke.
pat: thanks. i'll update release notes to mention partial rollback and region-specific mitigation. link will go to eng-release.
(20m)
sam: baked b12a and smoke ok in staging. triggering canary for ap-southeast only at 5% to verify.
deploy-bot: Canary region rollout start region=ap-southeast rollout_id=roll_3472109999_apc1 step=5% watch=8m image=engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12a
sre-ops: monitor shows stable memory and no driver warnings so far.
(8m)
sre-ops: 8m check clear. increasing to 20% in ap-southeast.
deploy-bot: progressed ap-southeast to 20% watch=8m
(8m)
sre-ops: ap-southeast healthy. no OOMs, p99 within baseline. recommend resuming global rollout.
chris: agree, but keep auto-fallback active and maintain extended pin until we confirm 2h post full cutover.
sam: resuming global rollout to 60% then 100%.
deploy-bot: Resumed global rollout step=60% watch=10m
pat: watching. please annotate canary group in release notes.
(10m)
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% -> engine:slim-quant-20240402-b12a. Partial rollback for ap-southeast earlier. Summary: peak_p95_diff=+11%, errors_peak=0.7%, OOMs=2 (ap-southeast, rolled back), driver_warnings=3 (nodes replaced). Pin id=pin_20240402_b12 retained and expires in 12h.
chris: action items: 1) follow-up RCA for driver + reorder interaction (assign to kernel team), 2) add ap-southeast shim to packaging, 3) update model-catalog note for quant variant.
sam: filing release ticket and tagging `kernel-team` and `packaging` groups.
pat: thx all. I'll post a short postmortem and the final perf graphs in eng-release in the morning. leaving pin to expire unless urgent. good run. :white_check_mark:
